notes: Games you have already finished are no longer offered back to you. The continue offers introduced in 3.10.0 were built from the game messages, which say nothing about how the game went, so a game you had won still asked you to come back to it. The result is now read from the game's own move log, which every device has, so a game your opponent finished while your card was closed counts as finished for you too. A game decided while you are watching keeps its card for a minute — the result is the best part — and is then put away for good; one that was already over when you opened the chat never takes the card at all; and closing a card yourself still simply closes it.
